metadata.note: CC-11.9 continuation: narrow cosmetic cleanup pass on v3 (removes a faint duplicate ghost arc), not a technical-fact retry. v3's own technical geometry was independently re-verified correct via zoomed pixel inspection before this pass.

audit.priorMisreadCorrection: The v3 audit (this package's own prior work) incorrectly found the S-side horizontal ray's arrowhead pointing outward (away from the magnet). On a zoomed pixel-level re-inspection (cropping a tight region around each horizontal ray's arrowhead independently, prompted by a Product Owner correction), the S-side arrowhead in fact points RIGHTWARD -- toward the magnet, i.e. into S -- exactly as it should for a field line entering S. The N-side arrowhead points rightward/outward, away from the magnet, correctly exiting N. Both are directionally correct; v3's field-line topology and direction were technically correct all along. This was a genuine visual-reading error in the prior audit, not a defect in the image -- corrected here after independent re-verification, not merely asserted on the Product Owner's authority.

factChecks.note: Full nested-loop topology present and unchanged from v3, minus one non-topological rendering artefact (see below).

factChecks.fact: external field direction runs N to S
factChecks.note: Re-verified via zoomed crops of both horizontal-ray arrowheads: the N-side (right) ray points outward, away from the magnet (field exiting N); the S-side (left) ray points inward, toward the magnet (field entering S). The nested arc loops all point toward S at their peaks, consistent with the same N-to-S circulation. All three line families agree with each other -- no self-contradiction.

factChecks.fact: field-line density used meaningfully where density is taught

prohibitedChangeChecks.prohibition: do not draw field lines that reverse direction or cross incorrectly
prohibitedChangeChecks.note: No reversal or incorrect crossing found on re-inspection.

cleanupPass.defectFound: A faint, pale, lower-opacity duplicate 'ghost' arc (no arrowhead) nested between the outermost loop and the next loop in, present both above and below the magnet in v3 -- a rendering artefact, not an intended field line.
cleanupPass.action: One narrow, bounded correction call: v3's own image supplied as the reference (not the original external DipolMagnet.svg reference), with an instruction to remove ONLY the faint duplicate arcs and change nothing else.
cleanupPass.result: Ghost arcs removed cleanly. Zoomed-crop comparison of both horizontal-ray arrowheads against v3 confirms identical direction/position -- no regression introduced. N/S labels, magnet body, background, and every solid field line preserved.

audit.styleComplianceNotes: White/near-white background correct. N/S labels correct and legible. Premium brushed-metal magnet rendering unchanged from v3.
audit.overallFindings: PASS. This asset's technical geometry (field-line topology and direction) was correct as of v3; the only real defect was a cosmetic rendering artefact (a faint duplicate ghost arc), now removed via one narrow cleanup pass that left every technical element unchanged (independently re-verified via zoomed pixel comparison, not merely assumed). unit202.magnet.field is production-candidate-ready pending Product Owner review.

factChecks.fact: fulcrum positioned between the effort point and the load point
factChecks.note: Single lever bar with the fulcrum wedge clearly positioned between the EFFORT end (left, with a hand-grip loop) and the LOAD end (right, with a cube load). Correct Class I ordering.

prohibitedChangeChecks.prohibition: do not blend this with the Class II or Class III arrangement
prohibitedChangeChecks.note: Exactly one lever diagram is present. No trace of the Class II or Class III sibling arrangements -- the prepared/cropped reference (isolating only the top subfigure) resolved the composite-reference defect that caused attempts 1-2 (CC-11.8) to fail on this exact point.

audit.styleComplianceNotes: White/near-white background correctly applied. Premium brushed-metal 3D rendering (industrial precision, tactile, adult/vocational character). Labels EFFORT, LOAD, FULCRUM all present, legible, and correctly positioned over their respective elements -- matches this asset's requiredLabels exactly.
audit.physicalImplausibilityNotes: None -- a single rigid bar pivoting on a triangular fulcrum with a hand-grip effort end and a cube load is physically coherent and plausible.
audit.overallFindings: Strong PASS on first attempt of this production run. The composite-reference crop (isolating the Class I subfigure before sending to Gemini) fully resolved the defect that blocked this asset in the earlier CC-11.8 proof (which had sent the full 3-class composite and got a blended result). No immutable fact violated, no prohibited change made, required labels present and correct.

audit.correctionNote: CC-11.12 semantic QA REDO: the review pack's own 'reference preview not found' finding was correct -- no real reference had ever actually been visible for this asset, and the resulting topology was ambiguous. factChecks.note: Single loop, explicitly labelled 'coil/loop'. No second loop-like structure anywhere in the image.
Single shaft with a rotation-indicator arrow, connecting the loop to the slip rings.

Output wires trace clearly from the brushes to the labelled Load.
Two full concentric rings, not a split ring -- correct for an AC generator, not a DC motor.
